summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 UI improvements (Local Worker token copy, auto-load of Setup-Reife table, Live/Sammel mode switch). All three tasks pass end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL.

task1_local_worker_token.details: Tools-Menu -> Backtester -> bt-exec-manage opens localworker-panel with lw-setup section open. lw-token-field present with 48-char token value auto-loaded. lw-token-copy NOT disabled, lw-cmd-copy NOT disabled. lw-token-show toggles input type from password to text. Clicking lw-token-copy triggers success toast (Text 'kopiert' found on page).

task2_setup_maturity_auto_load.details: After clicking edit-strategy-params-btn (AI Trader) and ai-equity-toggle, ai-equity-panel opens and ai-setup-maturity-table appears automatically within ~2s without pressing Aktualisieren. 16 ai-maturity-row-* rows rendered.

task3_live_collection_mode_toggle.details: ai-maturity-mode-tabs present with default 'live'. ai-maturity-mode-col-header initially reads 'Live n / WR / PnL'. Clicking ai-maturity-mode-collection switches header to 'Sammel n / WR / PnL'. Clicking ai-maturity-mode-live restores 'Live n / WR / PnL'. ai-setup-class-tabs (Gesamt/Krypto/Indizes/Rohstoffe/Forex) remains visible and functional.

critical_code_review_comments: Multiple 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' console errors during initial load (fetchSession/fetchNotif and 5 other useEffect fetches). Likely transient network/proxy issue rather than a code bug – app recovers and functions normally – but worth an early error boundary or retry to reduce log noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three UI improvements verified against preview URL. LocalWorkerPanel token is loaded via /api/localworker/token, panel opened via Tools menu -> Backtester -> bt-exec-manage. Admin login triggered by clicking any admin-protected button (edit-strategy-params-btn or tools-menu-backtester).
